Opaque account database handles, accessors, setters, lock guards, and speculative access checks.

# Purpose
Defines the account database handle types used by the Flamenco account cache layer. It provides opaque reference types for read-only and read-write access, plus inline accessors and setters for account metadata fields such as data, lamports, owner, executable flag, and slot. The file also defines small guard types for read and write lock tracking, and a speculative access type with a test function that checks whether a shared record key has changed. These declarations sit between the database layer and the runtime layer and expose direct record access with minimal protection.
